newsitem.title: GERMANY: WestLB expects nine month 96 op profit up 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: WestLB expects nine month 96 op profit up 10 pct.

text.p: Management board chairman of the Westdeutsche Landesbank Girozentrale, Friedel Neuber said on Wednesday he expected the bank's operating profit in the first nine months of 1996, after risk provisions, to rise by 10 percent.
Neuber said that profits in the full-year 1996 would stay around 1995 levels.
"We will hold 1996 profit levels at 1995 levels," he told reporters in Frankfurt.
In 1995 WestLB reported an operating profit, before risk provisions, of 1.829 billion marks ($1.21 billion), with net profits of 520 million marks.
